outcome: magnetic resonance (MR) imaging signs of cortical dysgenesis
signs of watershed injury to the visual cortex
cohort: Eight children with severe CVI and a clinical history of perinatal events were included.
finding: Some children with cortical visual impairment and a history of perinatal distress exhibit prenatal dysgenesis of the developing brain, suggesting that perinatal hypoxia-ischemia may be a secondary complication of a primary prenatal injury.
